_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (claudedocs/server.md, '单文件 500 行收敛'). checkFileLength.mjs fails CI only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, a listed file grows past the line count recorded here, or (2026-08-13, G3) an entry has no 'reason' or its 'lines' exceeds the 800-line hard cap. Schema: { "path": { "lines": <number>, "reason": "<why this is a justified exception>" } }. Splitting a file below 500 lines does not require touching this file (the script reports it as a housekeeping notice instead of failing) but you should still delete its entry and move it into claudedocs/server.md's 已完成 list. Do not bump a recorded 'lines' number to silence a GREW violation without also updating 'reason' to actually explain the growth — that defeats the point; split the file or, if truly justified, explain why. 2026-08-13: the original 30-file backlog from 2026-08-09 was fully split by 2026-08-11 (see claudedocs/server.md's '单文件 500 行收敛' section) — this baseline is currently empty (0 tracked entries, 0 files over 500 lines as of the last audit).
